findings.title: Reciprocal entry makes the day/night boundary dynamic

findings.title: A provocative service/labor analogy stays within provision
findings.claim: By analogy, the focus's cosmic subjection can evoke an uncompensated service relation, while its human-work and khabir clauses make the labor comparison ethically pointed.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace pairs focus sakhkhara with its forced-labor branch and focus amal with a manual-laborer branch, then returns both through 31:20's repeated subjection for human benefit and its beneficent-condition role. Khabir supplies the audit contact. This changes neutral cosmic instruments into a provocative service analogy, contained by the explicit beneficiary frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The contrast between cosmic service and human labor becomes visible without turning the focus into a literal labor law.
findings.containment: The focus verb does not lexically mean forced labor, and its finite verb does not mean manual laborers. The analogy asserts neither divine exploitation nor a replacement for purposeful subjection.

epistemic.reason: The HFT outlier has exact focus/context coordinates and contact, but both labor branches are deliberately form-distant analogies.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir şeyi istenen işe boyun eğdirip yöneltme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey, kimi zaman zor kullanılarak, belirli bir işe boyun eğdirilir ve istenen sonuca doğru yöneltilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus's purposeful-subjection branch is the primary carrier.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 31:20 repeats subjection for human benefit and pairs it with a beneficent-condition role.
branch_activations.activation: The wider beneficiary frame keeps the service reading in view as the labor analogy appears.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Cosmic subjection can be contemplated as service that benefits people.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus's ordinary purposeful-subjection meaning remains intact.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: karşılıksız zorla çalıştırma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kimse baskıyla çalıştırılır ve yaptığı iş için ücret ya da başka bir karşılık almaz.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus applies subjection to nonhuman luminaries for a beneficiary.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's human-work clause and 31:20's beneficiary/service wording provide a distinct labor relation.
branch_activations.activation: Service of nonhuman bodies for others can be analogized to compelled labor, while provision constrains the analogy.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The cosmic order can carry a provocative labor resonance.
branch_activations.boundary: This is not a lexical gloss or a claim of divine exploitation.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: el işçileri
branch_activations.facet_statement: Ellerini kullanarak çeşitli ağır işleri yapan insan topluluğu ana anlamdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus has a finite second-person verb meaning what people do/work, not a noun for laborers.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's cosmic service clause and 31:20's beneficiary frame form the other side of the labor comparison.
branch_activations.activation: The HFT trace maps human work to a laborer role as an analogy, linking service received with work performed.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final work clause makes the service/labor contrast ethically pointed.
branch_activations.boundary: The verbal form is not re-glossed as manual laborers; the branch survives only as analogy.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bilgi edinme, bildirme ve deneyerek iç yüzü tanıma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey veya olay hakkında edinilen ve aktarılabilen bilgiyi belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus says Allah is khabir regarding what people do.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The labor analogy places human work beside cosmic subjection and the wider beneficiary frame.
branch_activations.activation: Expert knowledge of work makes the comparison ethically pointed rather than merely mechanical.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Human labor remains within the order of service and knowledge.
branch_activations.boundary: No judgment about a particular human labor arrangement is asserted.

branch_activations.carrier: HFT attributes 31:20 word 15 to a beneficent or good condition.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus explicitly joins subjection and human work.
branch_activations.activation: The beneficiary condition limits the provocative labor reading to an analogy within service/provision.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The analogy remains framed by benefit rather than exploitation.
branch_activations.boundary: The context root is unresolved and its role remains attributed.

findings.title: Ingress can serve as a contained analogy for inward allegiance
findings.claim: The focus's literal night/day ingress can also serve as an analogy for how an outside pattern enters inward allegiance, persists through inherited following, and is later exposed by conduct.
findings.mechanism: 31:20 supplies attributed inner associates; 31:21 supplies loyal following of forebears; 31:32 supplies a betrayal/fidelity contrast after rescue. These roles contact focus ingress and khabir, changing the entry image into a bounded social analogy about what takes hold inside and what later action reveals.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus's inward-knowledge close can be contemplated alongside how concealed allegiance becomes legible in later conduct.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory social analogy, not a claim that people or beliefs are the literal night and day of 31:29.

epistemic.reason: Exact Arabic is supplied for all three contexts and each HFT role returns to focus carriers, but the social mapping is an attributed outlier.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bünyeye dışarıdan alınmış unsur veya aileden olmayan özel sırdaş
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi ya da şey, aslından olmadığı bir bütünün içine alınmıştır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus's causal ingress is literally between night and day.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider trace supplies intimate associates, inherited following, and later betrayal as social roles.
branch_activations.activation: The outsider-into-a-whole schema lets literal ingress resonate with a pattern entering inward allegiance.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Ingress can model how an outside influence becomes operative within a group.
branch_activations.boundary: The social actors remain analogical, not referents of the focus verb.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bünyeye dışarıdan alınmış unsur veya aileden olmayan özel sırdaş
branch_activations.facet_statement: Aileden olmayan bir kişi güvenilen özel çevreye ve iç ilişkilere alınabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus supplies the entry carrier, not a human social agent.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 31:20's attributed inner associates and 31:21's inherited following supply the private-allegiance context.
branch_activations.activation: The inward-circle specialization sharpens the analogy from entry into a whole to entry into its inner relations.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's entry image can illuminate how allegiance takes root inside a community.
branch_activations.boundary: No community or trusted associate is asserted in the literal focus.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bilgi edinme, bildirme ve deneyerek iç yüzü tanıma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey veya olay hakkında edinilen ve aktarılabilen bilgiyi belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus closes with expert knowledge of human work.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The context roles trace inner associates and following to later conduct marked as betrayal or fidelity.
branch_activations.activation: Later behavior supplies a social counterpart to what is already known inwardly.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's knowledge clause resonates with allegiance becoming visible through action.
branch_activations.boundary: The social inference is analogical and the context root roles remain attributed.

branch_activations.carrier: HFT attributes 31:20 word 17 to intimate inner associates.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Focus ingress and khabir supply the entry/interior contact.
branch_activations.activation: The attributed associates provide an inner social space into which an influence may enter.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The social analogy gains an inward location.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains unresolved; its role is attributed.

branch_activations.carrier: HFT attributes 31:21 words 4 and 10 to loyal succession/following.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Focus ingress gives a model of an incoming pattern; khabir supplies inward knowledge.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated following role shows how an admitted pattern may persist across generations.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Inward allegiance can become an inherited course of conduct.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent branch gloss is supplied.

branch_activations.carrier: HFT attributes 31:32 word 21 to betrayal or failure of fidelity.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's khabir term and the preceding admitted-allegiance analogy supply the contact.
branch_activations.activation: The later betrayal role provides an outcome that reveals what inward allegiance became.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Later conduct can expose the nature of an inwardly operative pattern.
branch_activations.boundary: The context reading is attributed and does not lexicalize betrayal into the focus.

findings.title: Seeing the luminaries' setting can test their claim to rule
findings.claim: The focus's seeing question, subjection of sun and moon, and bounded course can resonate with the sequence in which Abraham sees celestial bodies set and refuses to treat a setting luminary as lord.
findings.mechanism: 6:76-78 repeatedly joins seeing with a star, moon, and sun that set; 6:78 explicitly follows the sun's appearance and setting with disavowal of association. These wider triggers return through the focus's tara, sun, moon, and course terms, changing observation into an argument from finitude toward the sovereignty of the one who governs the bodies.
findings.reader_payoff: The celestial display can be perceived not only as orderly but as unable to bear ultimate rule because its bodies themselves pass and set.
findings.containment: This is a cross-text resonance, not a claim that 31:29 directly narrates Abraham or that sunset is lexically identical to the focus's appointed term.

epistemic.reason: The connection records provide exact target Arabic but no target morphology or trust labels; the reading is grounded as a surface-level resonance and bounded as an inference.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus opens by asking whether the audience sees or recognizes the sign.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 6:76-78 repeatedly narrates seeing a star, the moon, and the sun, followed by their setting.
branch_activations.activation: The same seeing frame is attached to bodies whose setting changes how their visible status is judged.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Seeing becomes a step from celestial appearance toward recognition of limitation.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not identify its addressees with Abraham or retell his sequence.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: güneş, güneş diski ve ışığı; güneşli olma ve güneşe çıkma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Güneş, gökteki bilinen cisim, onun görünen yuvarlak yüzü ve çevreye yayılan ışığıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus names the sun as a subjected, moving body.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 6:78 says Abraham sees the sun rise, then sees it set and rejects association.
branch_activations.activation: The focus carrier meets a wider scene in which solar appearance ends and cannot ground ultimate lordship.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The sun's visible course can be read as evidence of its limitation.
branch_activations.boundary: No astronomy beyond the supplied setting scene is claimed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Ay, ay ışığı ve ayla aydınlanan gece
branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel gönderim, gökte görülen Ay adlı gök cismidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus names the moon as the second subjected body.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 6:77 narrates the moon's appearance and setting in the same sequence of tested claims.
branch_activations.activation: The same celestial referent is judged through its setting.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The moon's course can be perceived as finite rather than sovereign.
branch_activations.boundary: The trigger does not add moonlight or phases to the focus.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir yol boyunca akıp, koşup ya da ilerleyerek gitme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir varlık kendi yolu boyunca akar, koşar ya da kesintisiz biçimde ilerler.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus assigns a continuing course to each luminary.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The moon and sun scenes culminate in setting rather than endless visible presence.
branch_activations.activation: A wider setting event contacts the focus's directed motion and makes its limit perceptible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The course is an ordered but finite movement.
branch_activations.boundary: Setting is not asserted to be the exact appointed endpoint named in the focus.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: belirlenmiş süre, son zaman ve o zamana erteleme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey için belirlenmiş süreyi ve bu sürenin vardığı son zamanı bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus explicitly places the courses under an appointed term.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider seeing sequence shows celestial bodies setting and thus supplies a distinct image of limitation.
branch_activations.activation: The endpoint carrier and setting trigger meet to make finitude part of the observed sign.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The luminaries' governed course is not self-grounding or endless.
branch_activations.boundary: The setting scenes do not specify the focus's appointed date.

friction_notes: The focus's reciprocal night/day wording supports interpenetration; the qualified n-h-r opening/widening branch is a root-level resonance, not a replacement gloss for day.
Connection targets supply exact Arabic but not target morphology. No target-side segmentation or lexical branch has been invented from a connection note.
HFT context traces are legacy_unbound: exact Arabic and stated word indices are used as attributed evidence, especially for unresolved branches, not as independent lexicon entries.
The gestational, ecological, labor, and social readings are analogical and remain contained by the primary temporal and purposeful-subjection readings; their HFT alternatives remain visible.

The named-term reading distinguishes a fixed designation from disclosure of its date. The wider written-debt term in 2:282 is a counterweight to any claim that appointed terms are universally inaccessible to humans.
